national_news.title: BRICS Sports Ministers Adopt Joint Declaration in Visakhapatnam
bullets: The BRICS Sports Ministers’ Meeting concluded in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, under India’s BRICS Chairship 2026 with the unanimous consensus adoption of the BRICS Sports Joint Declaration.

Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya proposed three key initiatives: a BRICS Working Group on Sports Technology, a BRICS Sports Manufacturing Conclave in Udaipur, and Traditional and Indigenous Sports Demonstration Games in Ahmedabad.
The declaration focuses on enhancing cooperation in sports technology, athlete and coach exchanges, sports science, and promoting sports manufacturing under the Make in India initiative.

national_news.title: India Celebrates 3rd National Space Day Highlighting $45-Billion Space Economy Vision
bullets: India celebrated National Space Day on August 23, marking the historic anniversary of Chandrayaan-3's successful landing on the Moon's south polar region in 2023.

Addressing the 3rd National Space Day celebrations in Ahmedabad, leaders emphasized space sector reforms designed to drive India towards a $45-billion space economy and support the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the growing role of private space startups, Gen-Z engineers, and global investment in expanding India's space ecosystem.

national_news.title: Rohit Yadav and Murali Sreeshankar Win Gold at World Athletics Continental Tour
bullets: Rohit Yadav won the javelin throw title with a personal best of 87.68 metres at the World Athletics Silver Level Continental Tour at Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar.
Murali Sreeshankar clinched the men's long jump title with a leap of 8.07 metres, while Ancy Sojan led an Indian sweep in the women's long jump with a 6.71-metre effort.
Abinaya Rajarajan (19) reclaimed the Indian Under-20 national record by winning the women's 100m event in 11.34 seconds.

national_news.title: India Must Move from 'Pharmacy' to 'Laboratory of the World': Union Minister Anupriya Patel
bullets: Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Anupriya Patel addressed the 3rd edition of the IIMA Healthcare Summit on 'Advancing AI in Healthcare' at IIM Ahmedabad.
Highlighted the setting up of Centres of Excellence for AI in healthcare at AIIMS New Delhi, PGIMER Chandigarh, and AIIMS Rishikesh.
Emphasized the ₹5,000 crore Promotion of Research and Innovation in Pharma-MedTech Sector (PRIP) scheme to boost innovation-led industry-academia research collaboration.

national_news.title: Centre Formed High-Level Committee for Gorkha Issue and Reviews Siliguri Corridor Security
bullets: Union Home Ministry announced the formation of a high-level committee chaired by Interlocutor Pankaj Singh (former BSF Director and Deputy NSA) to resolve Gorkha issues in the Darjeeling Hills, Terai, and Dooars within the constitutional framework.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah reviewed security arrangements along India's eastern borders at Sukna, Siliguri, focusing on strengthening the Siliguri Corridor ('Chicken's Neck').

Central security forces (BSF, SSB) and state administration discussed preparing a framework for a proposed 'Triangular Security Grid' near the international borders with Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh.
